meta.method: walk-london-datastore.mjs harvest solar-opportunity: 1 resources (csv); a row is kept when its TOID is a zone TOID (the OS MasterMap TopographicArea TOIDs of the OS Open UPRN points in the 3D model box, through OS Open Linked Identifiers; a building with no UPRN is missed). Sheets: the up to 3 rows above the first coded row are kept as header_rows. CSV: streamed; the first line is the header; a row is kept by its first TOID (osgb...).
